name: agentic-os
description: Self-improving agent memory system with 9 skills (session lifecycle, memory management, knowledge sync, policy-gated self-improve) and 6 hooks, including a PreToolUse shell circuit breaker and a PostToolUse dirty-state tracker (crash-safe consolidation via marker + recovery detection). Identity growth via gated candidate queues behind a conversation-only trust boundary that is enforced on enqueue AND on promotion; scaling thresholds live in one SSoT script. wrap-up applies every file mutation through a single batch writer (apply_wrapup.py) instead of one turn per write, and reports measured tallies rather than self-reported counts. Model/effort frontmatter is declared per skill (class SSoT in model-routing.sh) but measured inert as of 2026-07-27 — stage-0 preprocessing, escalation rules and cost-trace.jsonl remain effective; cost is dominated by context transport, not model class. MCP-Tool-Bridge Policy enforces clear roles (tool/introspection/knowledge) and hard no-gos against MCP-as-truth or cross-project mutation.
